span.p:
SC-011 exception, should
Given The sponsor read version 0.5.0. Section 5 has a score of 72, the lowest in the set.

div.style: color: rgb(31, 36, 48) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p: When The sponsor decides that section 5 is not good enough to approve.

div.style: color: rgb(31, 36, 48) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p: The sponsor rejects version 0.5.0, outside the viewer.

div.style: color: rgb(31, 36, 48) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p: The sponsor sends the decision and the reason, "section 5 scores 72", to the author.

div.style: color: rgb(31, 36, 48) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p: The author records the rejection and its reason in the change log.

div.style: color: rgb(31, 36, 48) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p: Then The author has the rejection and its reason. The change log records the rejection with a note, and the next export of the set still shows "Draft".
